summary: Examples of blockinfile: adding an sshd Match block with surrounding blank lines, network interface stanzas, a validated block from a local file, HTML with custom markers, removing a block, looping with per-item markers in /etc/hosts, and multiline regex insertion.
questions: How do I add a Match User block to sshd_config?
How do I add entries to /etc/hosts in a loop without overwriting?
How do I use HTML comment markers with blockinfile?
How do I remove a managed block and its markers?
How do I insert a block from a local file and validate it?

answer_card.title: blockinfile examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml - ansible.builtin.blockinfile: path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config append_newline: true prepend_newline: true block: | Match User ansible-agent PasswordAuthentication no - ansible.builtin.blockinfile: path: /var/www/html/index.html marker: "" insertafter: "" block: |

Welcome to {{ ansible_hostname }}

# remove: same marker, block: "" - ansible.builtin.blockinfile: path: /etc/hosts block: "{{ item.ip }} {{ item.name }}" marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED BLOCK {{ item.name }}" loop: - {name: host1, ip: 10.10.1.10} ``` Validate: `validate: /usr/sbin/sshd -T -f %s`.
